display_name: Butuga II of the Western Ganga
one_line: Western Ganga king and Rashtrakuta ally famed for his role in the Battle of Takkolam and the Atakur hero-stone inscription.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s, athletic and wiry with a battle-hardened, agile build.
appearance.face: Oval face with sharp jawline, medium brown Dravidian complexion, straight nose, neatly kept moustache with a short trimmed beard along the jaw, faint battle scar across the left eyebrow, default expression calm and focused with determined eyes.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair tied into a mid-length topknot at the back of the crown, sides combed back; bronze-gold cloth headband with a small central leaf-shaped metal ornament rests around the forehead.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate Western Ganga royal-warrior outfit: a knee-length off-white cotton angavastra-style tunic with short sleeves and subtle woven border, worn over a wrapped lower garment (dhoti/veshti) in deep indigo tied above the ankles with a narrow mustard-yellow border; a fitted dark maroon quilted cloth vamshika-style vest over the tunic for light armour, reinforced with narrow stitched bands; a broad brown leather belt with a simple bronze buckle at the waist, from which hangs a short utility pouch; forearms wrapped in off-white cloth bracers, with bronze bangles at the wrists; feet in sturdy brown leather sandals with straps looping around the ankles; jewellery limited to a simple bronze torque, small round bronze earrings, and a single beaded armlet on the upper right arm featuring dark red and black beads; a narrow dark green sash runs from left shoulder to right waist, hinting at his alliance with Rashtrakuta forces while still grounded in simple textiles.
appearance.signature: A straight, broad-bladed South Indian steel sword of the period with a gently tapering blade, simple crossguard, and wooden hilt wrapped in dark brown leather, carried in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard hanging from his belt on the left; his left hand often rests lightly on the hilt.

ref_desc: Butuga II is a mid-30s, medium-brown, moustached and short-bearded warrior-king with a black topknot and bronze headband, wearing an off-white tunic, deep indigo dhoti, dark maroon quilted vest, brown belt, leather sandals, minimal bronze jewellery, and carrying a straight steel sword in a brown scabbard with accents of mustard yellow and dark green.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Butuga II, a Western Ganga king in mid-10th century South India: a mid-30s, athletic man with medium-brown skin, an oval face, sharp jaw, straight nose, neat moustache and short trimmed beard along the jaw, plus a faint scar across his left eyebrow and a calm, determined expression. His thick black hair is pulled into a mid-length topknot at the back of the crown, with the sides combed back and a bronze-gold cloth headband around his forehead featuring a small central leaf-shaped metal ornament. He wears an off-white cotton tunic with short sleeves and a subtle woven border, reaching to just above the knee, over a wrapped deep indigo dhoti tied so it falls to the ankles with a narrow mustard-yellow border; over the tunic is a fitted dark maroon quilted cloth vest with narrow stitched bands as light armour. A broad brown leather belt with a simple bronze buckle cinches his waist and holds a small utility pouch, while a narrow dark green sash crosses from his left shoulder to his right waist. His forearms are wrapped in off-white cloth bracers with bronze bangles at the wrists; he has a simple bronze torque at the neck, small round bronze earrings, and a single beaded armlet with dark red and black beads on his upper right arm. He wears sturdy brown leather sandals with straps looping around his ankles. His signature weapon is a straight, broad-bladed South Indian steel sword with a gently tapering blade, simple crossguard, and a wooden hilt wrapped in dark brown leather, carried in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard hanging from his belt on the left, his left hand resting lightly on the hilt; keep the dominant colours off-white, deep indigo, dark maroon, mustard yellow, bronze, brown and dark green, and show him from front and side to emphasize his consistent hair, face, costume and sword.
